title: UiKit outside mount
description: A mount point outside the kit: the one entry in `mounted_in` an overlay writes, because there is no contract to derive it from. Both halves are required - the container is what a reader acts on, and the note is why no kit component fits, which is the whole reason this shape exists rather than the nearest component standing in for one.

container.description: Where the component is mounted, named as plainly as the reader will have to act on it - the kit ships no component for it, so there is no id to resolve.

note.description: Why the mount point is outside the kit, and what that container hands the component - a live instance, a render callback's arguments.
